How far from home

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
we find what it really is like to quit your day job and commit to a creative life adventure, for a year.

Summary:
Chanel was the creative director at an ad agency and Stevo was a graphic designer, collectivly they have been working in the advertising industry for 15 years. In 2015 they decided enough was enough, they want to choose life. So, they sold everything they owned, packed a bag and took off to create for no-one but themselves for one year. They traveled the globe creating and posting their photos and video's on Social media. Attracted by this couples free spirit and how they seemed to be living the dream, 117k people from around the world started following them instagram and various social media platforms. It wasn't all glamorous though, they worked medial labour jobs to pay for some of their travels. For the rest they started getting sponsored by hotels and brands to come and have a holiday and then post about it.
They have returned home to rest for 2 weeks and then they are off to Europe for another year, this time with their own brand behind them, How Far From Home. This has now become their business and if they can keep making it work, they can keep traveling and "living for memories not materials possessions


Further information:
I have proposed to Chanel and Steve that we do a piece where called "2 days in JHB with How Far From Home" We have planned an itinerary that will include nature and inner city cool. The angle for the piece is, how to leave the rat race and make a living off social media, an aspirational piece in a time of economic crises. A piece for young people.

Press Release:


How Far From Home?
Wake up every day dreading your 9 to 5 grind and predictable routine? What is it really like to quit your day job and commit to a creative life adventure? Carte Blanche meets a brave couple who ditched their corporate jobs for a year of travel, only to return home with a thriving online brand and viable social media business.


Script:


Time code CHARACTER / VISUAL
1 00:00 Claire link to camera Claire: In 2015 Chanel Cartel and Steve Durenberger had decided to sell everything they have quit their jobs in advertising and choose life. In the process they started a whole new kind of job, How Far From Home
2 00:19 V/O with pictures V/O: To document their travels around the world these two creative created an instagram account called How Far From Home. Little did they know that a year later their personal instagram account would be followed by a 17 000 people and become a profitable way for them to live their dream

3 00:31 Claire interviews Chanel and Steve Claire: so before you started on this big adventure what were you doing professionally?
Chanel: we were both in advertising, I worked in social media agencies the creative dire and Steve was an art director it was good, it was a career of about 8-9 years in the industry and yet we felt it wads almost too predictable
Steve: it kina felt like we were in a rut, the same thing every single day and we felt uninspired and I think creatively our work felt uninspired
Chanel: I reached a point were I almost I reach all the goals that I though I needed the house, the car great boy friend great job, I working out my career and I wasn’t happy I thought is this it? This me for the next 10 -30 years, I needed more and wanted more adventure more excitement I needed and adventure. And see where my life is headed and I think that kind of scared me.
4 01:24 V/o explaining V/O: IU think everyone has had this feeling in their lives that when everyday feels like the one before and you start living for the weekend but instead of just moaning about it this is how these two made a change and spent a year travelling around Europe, Australia, Asia and Africa
5 01:36 Chanel and Steve interview with Claire In 2014 we went to the design indaba Chanel: conference and we saw man by the name of Stephan and spoke about the power of time off. And what that means for him is that every 7 years he closes his agency for an entire year and takes a sabbatical

Steve: it was a concept that we were really really interested in and
Chanel: we saw this and said hang on if he can do it so are we. And so a year of planning started it wasn’t just the day after the conference we dove
Steve: it was to save enough money to keep us going for an entire year, we also had to plan what we wanted to do and we were going to travel on a low budget.

Claire: How much money did you have?

Chanel: I think lets just that if we bought two return flights 1st class ticket from Johannesburg to Europe or America it would’ve covered the entire year.

Claire: so what is the concept of how far5 from home come to that idea

Chanel: we have always been quite conceptual people and we wanted to have a story, we didn’t just want it a year in our lives we look back one day ands think remember that time? We wanted to have a story and before we left we came up with concept of how fare from home we thought it was nice and fitting because we how far can we travel but also how far can we push ourselves out of the comfort zone and that’s the reason we are taking those journey and our instagram account we both love photography and we both live instagram and so we said lets track will be travel

Steve: it’s a good way to document our travels so why not?

Chanel: so then we came up with the whole chalk board idea and now we track how far we have travelled I mean to date I think we have travelled around 126 000 km.


6 03:24 V/O V/O: After spending the morning hiking in the most beautiful parts of SA, we headed to the Johannesburg CBD for the 13th global instameet.
7 01:56 Jim Botha Today is the 13th worldwide instameet, so what that means that the whole world. Come together online with one hash tag and different cities in the world are organising city meets. So walks around the city to we take photos and we are going to be taking place in the Johannesburg one and I’m really excited for because the only other ones we have done are overseas so we are so excited to be doing this one with friends.
8 04:00 Gareth interview Gareth: Instagram initially started off with just a photography app that came up, people can share photo of their city, locations but it since developed into very serious social media platform. People can utilize the numbers of social media and put it in place they can monetise the numbers. They can monetise the number various ways thro ugh blogs, content collections, collaborate with brands you want to work on the platform in a visual way. But some people will just use it as a passion and out of that passion that were you can really see where they find ways to monetise it. Our friends of mine from how far From Home they’ve just done it out of a passion to travel then just developed point where they can take that element or audience that they have built up and share things and collaborate with brands and actually monetising from it.
04:52 Steve interview Steve: Allot of brands have approached up especial in the travel industry and they say listen can we give you a product and you try and experience see what you think and talk about it on your instagram page to your community

Chanel: we have partnered up with a couple of travel agencies and sent us on these tours, we would go create content for them and share our experience, that’s amazing I mean that’s definitely alliance we our brand that what we do.

Claire: So when did the instagram account move from just being a personal documentation to a brand that it is now?

Steve: once instagram it kind of of just exploded within the first two month of our travels featured us. We got an email that said they would like to feature us, we weren’t quite sure if it was a spam or not? They tweeted us to like a million users at the time and our phone just exploded it was just madness.

Claire: so you went from what following to what you at now?

Steve: I think it was from 400 odd to 117000

Claire: I mean as a brand what have been some of the key milestones because now you are trying to make a living of doing what you do and how has that unfolded?

Chanel: I mean the first thing that comes to mind is Huffington post one of the largest blogs in the world has contacted us and we no contribute there and like our story telling style and for me that was great and I never wrote I suddenly start writing with all this passion n0ow Huffington Post is asking us to write so for me that was massive

Steve: we have doe some online teaching classes. Through a platform called skill share which is a unbelievable learning platform which you can pretty much just tap into the mind of any creative person in the world that puts a class on there. We have done two classes and how to travel the world on a budget, which everyone should know. And the next is how to stay creative whilst traveling which I think is personal for us.

Chanel: Our travel cures travel blogs that’s been very enlighten for us on the knowledge we took to speak at the design indaba conference at the beginning of this year which is amazing because a creative that is the most aspirational thing and that was incredible. So all these opportunities never had if we staying in our normal lives.

Claire: you guys are influences that have been recognised by instagram could you give us some tips on how to grow your social media brand?

Steve: You need to tell the right story and the story that is different so find a niche you have to be doing something different then anyone else is doing.

Chanel: We are not the first people in the world to travel around the world, and witness it all. I think the reason that people kind of grabbed onto our story was because we had that little board and it became a look and became a thing “oh look there is the couple with the board,” and just by that tiny little thing suddenly were are a little different from all the travel accounts.

Claire: What’s do you foresee in the future

Chanel: I think we are living proof that if you question what society wants you to do, and go on a whim on a gut feeling that it can work and you can be really happy with what you do every day and if we could bec0ome the go to cub of that concept you know follow your gut and do what you love that would be amazing

10 08:08 V/O – montage of packing V/O: Chanel and Steve are off again for an indefinite amount of time, they going back to Europe, Australia and maybe America creating online content for brands in the world and their social media brand How Far from Home
